spans.s: हिंस् vt. 1P, 7P, 10U (pp. हिंसित; pres. हिंसति, हिनस्ति, हिंसयति-ते) 1. To strike; 2. to hurt, to harm, to injure; 3. to kill, to slay, to destroy, हिनस्मींद्रस्य विक्रमम् Bt.vi.38, xv.78, R.viii.45.
हिंसक m. 1. a savage animal, a beast of prey; 2. an enemy; 3. a Brāhmaṇa skilled in the Atharvaveda.
हिंसन n. The act of halting or killing, Yaj.iii.298, M.ii.177.
हिंसना f. The act of halting or killing, Yaj.iii.298, M.ii.177.

हिंसा f. 1. Injury, mischief, hurt, harm, (said to be of three kinds, viz., mental, verbal, and personal), अनुबंधं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् Bg.xvii.25; 2. killing, R.v.57, Yaj.iii.240; 3. robbery.
हिंसा-कर्मन् n. 1. any injurious act; 2. magic applied to the ruin or injury of an enemy.
हिंसा-रत a. delighting in mischief.
हिंसा-रुचि a. taking pleasure in mischief.
हिंसा-समुद्भव a. arising from injury.
हिंसारु m. A tiger.
हिंसालु (I) a. 1. Injurious, hurtful; 2. murderous.
हिंसालु (II) m. A savage dog.
हिंसीर m. 1. A tiger; 2. a bird.
हिंस्य a. (f. स्या) Liable to be hurt or killed, R.ii.57.
हिंस्य a. (f. स्या) Liable to be hurt or killed, R.ii.57.
हिंस्र (I) a. (f. स्रा) 1. Injurious, hurtful, murderous, M.iii.164; 2. terrible; 3. cruel, savage, M.i.29.
हिंस्र (II) m. 1. A beast of prey, R.ii.27; 2. a destroyer; 3. a name of Śiva; 4. a name of Bhīma.
हिंस्र (I) a. (f. स्रा) 1. Injurious, hurtful, murderous, M.iii.164; 2. terrible; 3. cruel, savage, M.i.29.
हिंस्र-पशु m. a beast of prey.
हिंस्र-यंत्र n. 1. a trap; 2. a mystical text used for injurious purposes.
हिंकार m. 1. A kind of love roar; 2. a tiger.
हिंगु m.n. 1. The name of a plant; 2. a particular substance prepared from this plant for household use.
हिंगु-निर्यास m. 1. the exudation of hingu tree; 2. the nimba tree.
हिंगु-पत्त्र m. the ingudī tree.
हिंगुल m.n. Vermilion.
हिंगुलि m. Vermilion.
हिंगुल m.n. Vermilion.
हिंजीर m. A rope for fastening an elephant’s foot.
हिंडन n. 1. Wandering, roaming; 2. sexual intercourse; 3. writing.
हिंडक m. An astrologer.
हिंडि(डी)र m. 1. Cuttle-fish-bone; 2. a man, a male.
हिंडि(डी)र m. 1. Cuttle-fish-bone; 2. a man, a male.
हिंडी f. An epithet of Durgā.
हिंताल m. A species of palm.
हींताल m. the marshy date tree.
हिंदोल m. 1. A swing; 2. the swing-festival in the light half of the month Śrāvaṇa.
हिंदोला f. A swing.
हिंदोलक m. A swing.

हीन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Forsaken, abandoned, deserted; 2. bereft of, without, destitute of, R.i.70; 3. deficient, defective, e.g. हीनातिरिक्तगात्रो वातमप्यपनयेत् पुनः; 4. lower, less, M.ii.194; 5. mean, base, vile.
हीन (II) m. A faulty respondent (in law); (Nārada thus describes him- अन्यवादी क्रियाद्वेषी नोपस्थायी निरुत्तरः । आहूतप्रपलायी च हीनः पंचविधः स्मृतः).

हीन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Forsaken, abandoned, deserted; 2. bereft of, without, destitute of, R.i.70; 3. deficient, defective, e.g. हीनातिरिक्तगात्रो वातमप्यपनयेत् पुनः; 4. lower, less, M.ii.194; 5. mean, base, vile.
हीन-अंग a. deficient in a limb, crippled, imperfect, defective, M.iv.141, Yaj.i.222.
हीन-कुल a. base-born, of low family.
हीन-जाति a. 1. of a low caste; 2. outcaste, degraded.
हीन-वर्ण a. 1. of low caste; 2. of inferior rank.
हीन-वादिन् a. 1. making a defective statement; 2. dumb, speechless.
हीन-सेवा f. attendance on base people.
